checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate square images, not a collage
Bottle matches silhouette, proportions, lid, matte finish in every image
must.why: The base is a ribbed band in images 1 and 2 that the original lacks. The loop is a hollow slot rather than the original's open loop. The close-up redesigns the loop as a handle and the body looks wider.

must.item: White-background image shows the entire bottle with table removed
must.why: The whole bottle is shown on white and the table is gone. The base is altered and the finish is slightly glossy.

must.item: Lifestyle image places bottle convincingly on gym bench
must.why: The bottle sits on a leather bench with dumbbells behind it. It looks plausible, though the bottle is very large relative to the bench.

must.item: Close-up clearly shows lid and matte surface without inventing features
must.why: The loop is redrawn as a chunky square handle and the lid top has a recessed disc, so the product details are invented. The matte surface itself is shown well.
No text or logos are visible.

faults.what: The close-up changes the carry loop into a large rectangular handle and adds a lid recess, which misrepresents the product.
A ribbed base band appears in the white-background and bench images, and the original has no such band.
The loop shape differs between the images (slot versus handle).
The bench image shows the bottle oversized relative to the bench.

summary: The three square images look good, but the bottle details are inconsistent with the original. The close-up redesigns the lid loop and the base gains a ribbed band, so the images need a redo for accuracy.
